startups_long_startups_seo.answer: Technical and on-page fixes usually move impressions within 3–6 weeks. Meaningful ranking and enquiry growth typically lands in months 3–6, with compounding gains after that. Sites with existing authority move faster than new domains.

startups_which_keywords_matter.question: Which keywords matter most for startups?
startups_which_keywords_matter.answer: The highest-value clusters are "best <category> tool 2026" comparison searches; "alternative to <incumbent>" switching queries; problem-aware questions typed into ChatGPT and Perplexity. We prioritise commercial intent first, then supporting informational content that feeds both search rankings and AI answers.

startups_get_startups_brands.question: How do you get startups brands mentioned by ChatGPT and Perplexity?
startups_get_startups_brands.answer: For a startup, being cited by ChatGPT or Perplexity is often cheaper than ranking #1 on Google — there is far less competition for structured, verifiable answers than for authority-driven blue links.

startups_structured_data_implement.question: What structured data do you implement for startups?
startups_structured_data_implement.answer: We deploy SoftwareApplication + Organization + FAQPage alongside sitewide Organization and BreadcrumbList markup, validated against Google's Rich Results Test and kept in sync as content changes.

startups_also_handle_paid.answer: Yes. Google Ads and social advertising run alongside SEO so you have demand today while organic and AI visibility compound. Many clients start with paid for speed and shift budget to organic as rankings mature.

startups_which_kpis_report.question: Which KPIs do you report for startups?
startups_which_kpis_report.answer: We report share of ai answers mentioning the brand, branded search volume growth, demo requests from organic and ai referrals, comparison-page conversion rate — plus AI visibility tracking that shows how often your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

startups_work_manual_safe.question: Is the work manual and safe for startups sites?
startups_work_manual_safe.answer: Every link, citation and content asset is produced manually. We use no PBNs, no automated link tools and no AI-spun content — critical in a sector where zero domain authority competing with funded incumbents.

startups_work_with_our.question: Can you work with our existing startups website?
startups_work_with_our.answer: Yes. We audit and improve what you have first — most sites gain more from fixing crawlability, structure and content depth than from a rebuild. If a rebuild genuinely pays back, our web team can handle it.
